observation.command: cat /etc/docker/daemon.json 2>/dev/null; echo "---env proxy---"; env | grep -iE "proxy" | sed 's/=.*/=<set>/'; echo "---docker pull verbose test---"; DOCKER_CONFIG=/tmp/dc timeout 60 docker pull minio/minio:latest 2>&1 | tail -4
